title: Block Earner launches Earner
description: Block Earner began offering fixed-yield USD Earner, Gold Earner and Crypto Earner products to Australian consumers.
notes: The exact commencement date is recorded in ASIC's amended concise statement and later judgments.

title: Block Earner ceases offering Earner
description: Block Earner stopped offering and marketing the fixed-yield Earner product after ASIC raised licensing concerns.
notes: The separate Access product and current Block Earner services are outside this event.

title: ASIC commences civil proceedings
description: ASIC sued Web3 Ventures Pty Ltd alleging unlicensed financial services and operation of an unregistered managed investment scheme in relation to Earner and other products.
notes: The proceeding addressed Earner and the separate Access product; this record follows only the Earner findings.

title: Federal Court finds Earner required licensing
description: The Federal Court found that Earner was a financial product, that Block Earner provided unlicensed financial services and that the product operated as an unregistered managed investment scheme.
notes: The Court rejected ASIC's equivalent case against the separate Access product.

title: Federal Court grants penalty relief
description: The Federal Court relieved Block Earner from liability to pay a pecuniary penalty after finding that it acted honestly in an uncertain regulatory environment.
notes: The contravention declarations remained; the ruling concerned penalty relief and costs.

title: Full Federal Court reverses licensing finding
description: The Full Federal Court allowed Block Earner's cross-appeal and held that Earner was not a financial product requiring a financial services licence.
notes: This ruling was later overturned by the High Court.

title: High Court unanimously rules Earner was a financial product
description: The High Court of Australia unanimously held that Earner was a facility through which users made a financial investment and a derivative, and that Block Earner required an Australian financial services licence.
notes: The matter was remitted for determination of ASIC's penalty appeal.

title: Flint Money begins operating
description: Flint launched a consumer crypto yield application offering fixed returns on stablecoin and other digital-asset balances.
notes: Launch date is recorded at month-level.

title: Flint issues unlend and withdrawal instructions
description: Flint published instructions for users to unlend and withdraw as the flagship yield service was phased out under regulatory uncertainty.
notes: The notice stated that withdrawals could take several days and did not itself prove universal completion.

title: Flint Labs confirms Flint Money closure
description: Flint Labs described Flint Money as its closed first flagship project and outlined its pivot to other products.
notes: The event date is the first-party retrospective publication date, not a verified exact final customer-service cutoff.
